title: Native rainfall-ponding-runoff threshold-response frontier
purpose: Quantify the D21 native surface-threshold displacement over the already frozen rainfall ladder and determine whether FMC is competitive with the existing R2 physical-reduction comparator on fast surface-boundary response, without retuning thresholds or requiring matched regime labels.

predecessor_authority.D21_threshold_mismatch: At 2 Ksat SWAP R16 dynamic-top is ponded without runoff while full FMC one-step accounting already produces positive runoff.

common_context.bottom_boundary: not evaluated; this is a top-boundary response function, not a Richards trajectory

R16.top_state: exact 0-10 cm average of D16 I_DEEP profile

R2.top_state: exact 0-80 cm average of the same D16 I_DEEP profile

FMC.state: D16 I_DEEP connected fronts; zero initial surface store; no slugs or groundwater front
FMC.infiltration: D14/D16 Eq.18 connected-front kinematics with h_p=committed initial surface store=0
FMC.allocation: D15 left-to-right finite-volume allocation over existing fronts

response_outputs_per_factor: native regime class: FLUX_NO_PONDING / PONDED_NO_RUNOFF / ACTIVE_RUNOFF

threshold_metrics.ponding_onset_factor: lowest frozen ladder factor with surface store > 0
threshold_metrics.runoff_onset_factor: lowest frozen ladder factor with runoff > 0
threshold_metrics.onset_distance_to_R16: absolute log2(candidate onset factor / R16 onset factor)
threshold_metrics.regime_mismatch_count: number of seven ladder factors whose native regime differs from R16

curve_metrics.factors: all seven frozen factors with equal weight

all_required: FMC ponding-onset log2 distance to R16 <= R2 distance
FMC runoff-onset log2 distance to R16 <= R2 distance

interpretation_boundary.if_positive: Fast surface-threshold research candidacy may be retained and a separately preregistered short accepted-trajectory experiment may be considered.
interpretation_boundary.if_negative: Fast rainfall/ponding/runoff threshold candidacy is not retained relative to R2. Do not retune the surface model; preserve FMC candidacy only for already supported non-threshold purposes.
interpretation_boundary.neither_outcome: Neither outcome authorizes production ROM, application acceptance, formal runtime claims, ET/root physics or groundwater coupling.
